name: gha_shell_python3
title: 'shell: python3' is not a valid GitHub Actions shell
symptom: A workflow step with shell: python3 silently fails or is ignored
cause: GitHub Actions only recognizes: bash, sh, python, pwsh, cmd, powershell. 'python3' is not valid
fix: Use 'shell: python' (or bash) instead of 'shell: python3'
